svg.title: Zava Forward technical architecture
svg.desc: Zava Forward / service architecture. CTO + technical architects / PR #68 source baseline / 14 October 2026 / static view, not a live Azure inventory. GREEN: documented core | BLUE: source-configured | PURPLE: conditional / OFF | AMBER: deferred, not working services. Azure resource group ama / UK South exercise / development public-network exceptions. Container Apps environment / VNet + mTLS configured. CONFIGURED. Microsoft Entra ID. Existing workbench registration App roles + tenant issuer. HUMAN. Staff browser. Public welcome; protected /app + APIs Resident contact is staff-assisted. CONFIGURED. Configured map tile provider. Browser-only HTTPS tile requests List / cluster alternative stays usable. CONFIGURED. Microsoft Graph. Delegated own-user User.Read GET /me/photo/$value; server proxy. CONFIGURED. Managed identities. API + token maintenance identities Separate deferred worker identities. CONFIGURED. Azure Key Vault. Entra client secret + token-store SAS API read; maintenance writes one secret. CONDITIONAL. Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI. Account + project; standard and capable deployments standard: gpt-4.1-mini / capable: gpt-4.1 API managed-identity invocation; typed output validation No Foundry Agent Service / autonomous manager deployed. CONFIGURED. Container Apps HTTPS ingress + EasyAuth. 443 -> 8088 / /healthz probe / public welcome, protected /app + APIs Validated principal -> SQL staff binding -> server-side role/case/field checks. OBSERVED. ca-forward-test-api / UI + Python API. One deployable, not five microservices Deterministic workflow / ranking / consent / independent approvals Five shared assists: capture -> reserve -> infer -> validate -> store draft SQL owns dedupe, leases, durable limits and source-verified review. Normal five-assistant authority absent / proactive OFF. Disabled or failed assistance never blocks ordinary case controls.. OBSERVED. Azure SQL Database / retrofit. Entra-only / serverless / append-only ledger events Cases, row versions, audit, proposals, snapshots, leases + usage Short transactions; model call outside database locks 14-day PITR configured; restore acceptance remains separate. CONFIGURED. Azure Blob Storage / evidence. Private containers; upload / download through the API Document bytes in Blob; references + content hashes in SQL Five-assistant capture uses permitted metadata, not whole files. CONFIGURED. Separate auth-token Blob store. Private auth-tokens / EasyAuth SAS No browser token retrieval. CONFIGURED. Container Apps renewal job. 03:00 UTC / 5-day user-delegation SAS Own identity; one Key Vault secret write. CONFIGURED. Azure Container Registry. Digest-pinned image pull with workload identities Operator builds; CI tests, scans and produces SBOM, not auto-deploy. CONFIGURED. Azure Monitor / Log Analytics. Resource / container diagnostics + SQL audit API structured-trace coverage not established. CONFIGURED. Application Insights. Workspace-linked component Connection string; tracing unproved. CONFIGURED. Alerts / action group / Cost Management. API 5xx + restarts / SQL CPU / model client errors -> email Budget: 80% actual + 100% forecast; alerts are not a hard cap. Network topology / IaC. VNet default: 10.40.0.0/16 snet-aca: 10.40.0.0/23 snet-pe: 10.40.4.0/24 Private endpoints + DNS + NSGs SQL / Blob / Queue / KV / ACR Foundry / Monitor (AMPLS) Dev also permits public access. No private-only production claim. PaaS boxes are NOT VNet-hosted.. Deferred ADR 0001 topology / placeholder workloads, not the five-assistant runtime. DEFERRED. Separate agent Container App. Placeholder / KEDA agent-tasks scale 0-5 Proposed context + proposals through API only No SQL / Blob / Key Vault credential. DEFERRED. Azure Queue Storage. agent-tasks + agent-tasks-poison import-jobs + import-jobs-poison Defined resources, not running business flows. DEFERRED. Container Apps orchestrator job. Placeholder / five-minute schedule Proposed deterministic checkpoints through API Enqueues tasks; not an autonomous supervisor. DEFERRED. Container Apps import job. Placeholder / import-jobs event scale 0-2 Proposed validated import to limited SQL role Quarantine via Blob; no workbook write-back. DEFERRED. Same evidence storage account. imports / quarantine / exports / audit-archive Containers defined in Bicep Immutable digest anchoring NOT implemented. DEFERRED. Front Door Premium + WAF. Intended public edge / private backend Not deployed in this Bicep or exercise Current development ingress stays direct. CONDITIONAL. M365 / external connectors. SharePoint / Excel import: proposed Sites.Selected + per-site grant Teams Workflows: optional ops alerts No live sending, submission or approval Not a second system of record. Five-assistant inference never holds database locks and never approves domain changes. Responses are implicit unless double-headed. Blue arrows are configured relationships, not proof of end-to-end telemetry or private-only access. Deferred boxes are not working code. Email / Teams alerts do not replace owned safety response. Historical Decision 1 evaluation is not a current API runtime dependency.. Sign-in. HTTPS. Verified principal. SQL / MI. Blob / MI. Scoped model request / usage. Delegated own-photo request / image. Tile images. Delegation key. KEDA / tasks. import-jobs. Quarantine. Proposed API contract only. Proposed one-way snapshot import. Optional Teams Workflows alert

g.text: CTO + technical architects / PR #68 source baseline / 14 October 2026 / static view, not a live Azure inventory
GREEN: documented core | BLUE: source-configured | PURPLE: conditional / OFF | AMBER: deferred, not working services
Azure resource group ama / UK South exercise / development public-network exceptions
Container Apps environment / VNet + mTLS configured
API read; maintenance writes one secret
Account + project; standard and capable deployments
API managed-identity invocation; typed output validation
No Foundry Agent Service / autonomous manager deployed
Validated principal -> SQL staff binding -> server-side role/case/field checks
Deterministic workflow / ranking / consent / independent approvals
Five shared assists: capture -> reserve -> infer -> validate -> store draft
SQL owns dedupe, leases, durable limits and source-verified review
Normal five-assistant authority absent / proactive OFF.
Disabled or failed assistance never blocks ordinary case controls.
Cases, row versions, audit, proposals, snapshots, leases + usage
Short transactions; model call outside database locks
14-day PITR configured; restore acceptance remains separate
Private containers; upload / download through the API
Document bytes in Blob; references + content hashes in SQL
Five-assistant capture uses permitted metadata, not whole files
Own identity; one Key Vault secret write
Digest-pinned image pull with workload identities
Operator builds; CI tests, scans and produces SBOM, not auto-deploy
API 5xx + restarts / SQL CPU / model client errors -> email
Budget: 80% actual + 100% forecast; alerts are not a hard cap
Deferred ADR 0001 topology / placeholder workloads, not the five-assistant runtime
Proposed context + proposals through API only
No SQL / Blob / Key Vault credential
Defined resources, not running business flows
Enqueues tasks; not an autonomous supervisor
Proposed validated import to limited SQL role
Quarantine via Blob; no workbook write-back
Not deployed in this Bicep or exercise
No live sending, submission or approval
Not a second system of record
Five-assistant inference never holds database locks and never approves domain changes. Responses are implicit unless double-headed.
Blue arrows are configured relationships, not proof of end-to-end telemetry or private-only access. Deferred boxes are not working code.
Email / Teams alerts do not replace owned safety response. Historical Decision 1 evaluation is not a current API runtime dependency.
